newsitem.title: USA: TCF gets Fed approval for Winthrop deal.
newsitem.headline: TCF gets Fed approval for Winthrop deal.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Monday the Federal Reserve Board has approved its planned acquisition of Winthrop Resources Corp, a company that leases business equipment.
The acquisition is still subject to approval by TCF and Winthrop shareholders at special meetings on June 24, and certain other conditions, bank holding company TCF said.

Assuming both companies' shareholders approve and other conditions are met, the deal is expected to close on or shortly after June 24, TCF said. The deal will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, it said.
Under terms of the deal, TCF will exchange about 6.7 million of its shares for Winthrop's common shares, or 0.7766 TCF share per Winthrop share.
TCF shares were down 1/8 at 42-3/8 Monday and Winthrop shares were down 1/4 at 31-5/8.
